title: Fast food restaurant?
content: Anyone else dream about a fast food restaurant outside of the mall? I always dream I am either waiting on the drive thru line or waiting on the indoor line. they sell different things every time. Sometimes ice cream, sometimes burgers, but I am almost always waiting in line. There is also always a mechanic right next door that I usually get stuck going to. It almost feels like it’s right next to the parking lot of the mall because I always know it’s right there even if I don’t see it.
